The '''Valfin Labor Camps Insurgence''' was an event that occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after the establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It took place at the [[Valfin labor camps]], a [[Prison/Legends|penal]] institution located in the [[Valfin system/Legends|Valfin system]]<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Valfin labor camps]] and the Valfin Labor Camps Insurgence|system=[[Valfin system/Legends|Valfin system]]|legends=1}}</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Meram sector/Legends|Meram sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Imperial Space|controlled]] by the shrinking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==The insurgence==
The Valfin Labor Camps Insurgence saw the first collaboration of [[Slar-dan ti Gardi]] with the infamous [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Borun Call]], who introduced the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] criminal to the [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]]. During the event, at least three [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] escaped from the [[Valfin labor camps]], only to be captured by the two slavers, who sold them for a profit.<ref name="AJ8" />

Eventually, the Valfin Labor Camps Insurgence was put to an end.<ref name="AJ10" />

==Aftermath==
Shortly after the quelling of the Valfin Labor Camps Insurgence, Gardi captured [[Krotorra]] and [[Lamorrack]], two [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] who, unbeknownst to him, were [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] representatives from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="AJ10" />
